goal: Establish a unified project-wide error handling strategy for Bitcoin Core
Resolve recurring ad hoc debates over when to use exceptions, return types, or process aborts
agreement: Concept approval for establishing a unified error handling strategy (sedited, josibake, willcl-ark)
Unaddressed objection: contradicts existing codebase patterns and adds technical debt (ajtowns)
Object to fail-fast aborts risking wallet corruption or node crashes (furszy, mzumsande, stickies-v)
Object to broader exception use due to non-local control flow and deadlock risks (l0rinc, maflcko)

categories.name: docs
why: P2 because it establishes project-wide error handling guidance to resolve recurring architectural disputes
It provides leverage across multiple validation and subsystem changes debating error handling
